metadata.cypher_query:
MATCH (e:Employee)
WHERE e.department IS NOT NULL AND e.hourly_rate IS NOT NULL
WITH e.department AS department, AVG(e.hourly_rate) AS avg_hourly_rate
WITH collect({department: department, avg_hourly_rate: avg_hourly_rate}) AS dept_stats, max(avg_hourly_rate) AS max_avg_hourly_rate
UNWIND dept_stats AS stat
WITH stat, max_avg_hourly_rate
RETURN stat.department AS department,
       stat.avg_hourly_rate AS avg_hourly_rate,
       CASE WHEN stat.avg_hourly_rate = max_avg_hourly_rate THEN true ELSE false END AS is_highest_department
ORDER BY avg_hourly_rate DESC

MATCH (e:Employee)-[:HAS_POSITION]->(pos:Position)
WITH e.name AS employee,
     max(e.years_experience) AS years_experience,
     pos.name AS position,
     max(pos.min_years) AS min_years,
     max(pos.max_years) AS max_years
WHERE years_experience IS NOT NULL AND min_years IS NOT NULL AND max_years IS NOT NULL
WITH employee, years_experience, position, min_years, max_years,
     CASE
       WHEN years_experience >= min_years AND years_experience <= max_years THEN '일치'
       WHEN years_experience < min_years THEN '과소경력'
       WHEN years_experience > max_years THEN '과다경력'
       ELSE '판단불가'
     END AS match_status
WITH position, match_status, COUNT(DISTINCT employee) AS employee_count
RETURN position, match_status, employee_count
ORDER BY position ASC, employee_count DESC

MATCH (e:Employee)
WHERE e.hire_date IS NOT NULL
WITH date(e.hire_date).year AS hire_year, COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) AS new_hires
RETURN hire_year, new_hires
ORDER BY hire_year ASC

MATCH (e:Employee)-[:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)
WITH e.name AS employee, MAX(e.max_projects) AS max_projects, COUNT(DISTINCT p.name) AS actual_projects
WHERE actual_projects > max_projects
RETURN employee, max_projects, actual_projects, (actual_projects - max_projects) AS exceeded_by
ORDER BY exceeded_by DESC, actual_projects DESC
LIMIT 200

MATCH (e:Employee)-[:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill)
WITH s.name AS skill, COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) AS employee_count
RETURN skill, employee_count
ORDER BY employee_count DESC, skill ASC
LIMIT 10

MATCH (s:Skill)
WHERE s.market_demand = $marketDemand
OPTIONAL MATCH (e:Employee)-[:HAS_SKILL]->(s)
WITH s.name AS skill, COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) AS employee_count
RETURN skill, employee_count
ORDER BY employee_count ASC, skill ASC
LIMIT 1

MATCH (e:Employee)-[r1:HAS_SKILL]->(s1:Skill)
WHERE toLower(s1.name) = toLower($skillPython)
  AND r1.proficiency = $proficiency
MATCH (e)-[r2:HAS_SKILL]->(s2:Skill)
WHERE toLower(s2.name) = toLower($skillML)
  AND r2.proficiency = $proficiency
WITH e.department AS department, COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) AS employee_count
RETURN department, employee_count
ORDER BY employee_count DESC
LIMIT 200

MATCH (e:Employee)-[r:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill)
WITH e.name AS employee, max(e.job_type) AS job_type,
     COUNT(DISTINCT s.name) AS skill_count,
     AVG(r.effective_rate) AS avg_effective_rate_per_employee
WITH job_type,
     AVG(skill_count) AS avg_skill_count,
     AVG(avg_effective_rate_per_employee) AS avg_effective_rate
RETURN job_type, avg_skill_count, avg_effective_rate
ORDER BY job_type

MATCH (p:Project)
WHERE p.budget_allocated IS NOT NULL AND p.budget_allocated <> 0 AND p.budget_spent IS NOT NULL
WITH p.status AS status,
     SUM(p.budget_spent) AS total_budget_spent,
     SUM(p.budget_allocated) AS total_budget_allocated
RETURN status,
       total_budget_spent,
       total_budget_allocated,
       toFloat(total_budget_spent) / total_budget_allocated AS execution_rate
ORDER BY execution_rate DESC

MATCH (p:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)<-[:WORKS_ON]-(e:Employee)
WITH p.name AS project,
     max(p.required_headcount) AS required_headcount,
     COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) AS actual_headcount
WHERE actual_headcount < required_headcount
RETURN project, required_headcount, actual_headcount, (required_headcount - actual_headcount) AS shortage
ORDER BY shortage DESC, project ASC
LIMIT 200

MATCH (e:Employee)-[w:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)
WITH p.name AS project, COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) AS employee_count, AVG(w.contribution_percent) AS avg_contribution_percent
RETURN project, employee_count, avg_contribution_percent
ORDER BY employee_count DESC, avg_contribution_percent DESC
LIMIT 5

MATCH (p:Project)
WITH p.type AS project_type,
     AVG(p.budget_million) AS avg_budget_million,
     AVG(p.duration_months) AS avg_duration_months,
     COUNT(*) AS project_count
RETURN project_type,
       avg_budget_million,
       avg_duration_months,
       project_count
ORDER BY project_type

MATCH (p:Project)-[req:REQUIRES]->(s:Skill)
WHERE req.importance = '필수' AND req.required_proficiency IN ['고급']
MATCH (e:Employee)-[hs:HAS_SKILL]->(s)
WHERE hs.proficiency IN ['고급', '전문가']
WITH p.name AS project, e.name AS employee, max(e.department) AS department,
     COUNT(DISTINCT s.name) AS matched_required_skills,
     COUNT(DISTINCT s.name) AS total_required_skills
MATCH (p2:Project)-[req2:REQUIRES]->(s2:Skill)
WHERE p2.name = project AND req2.importance = '필수' AND req2.required_proficiency IN ['고급']
WITH project, employee, department, matched_required_skills, COUNT(DISTINCT s2.name) AS total_required_skills
WHERE matched_required_skills = total_required_skills
RETURN department AS department, COUNT(DISTINCT employee) AS qualified_employee_count
ORDER BY qualified_employee_count DESC, department ASC

MATCH (e:Employee)-[w:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)
WHERE p.status = $projectStatus AND w.role = $role
OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:HAS_POSITION]->(pos:Position)
WITH e.name AS employee, max(pos.name) AS position
WITH coalesce(position, $unknownPosition) AS position, COUNT(DISTINCT employee) AS employee_count
RETURN position, employee_count
ORDER BY employee_count DESC, position ASC

MATCH (e:Employee)-[:HAS_CERTIFICATE]->(c:Certificate)
WITH e.name AS employee, COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS certificate_count
OPTIONAL MATCH (e2:Employee)-[:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)
WHERE e2.name = employee AND p.status = '진행중'
WITH employee, certificate_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.name) AS active_project_count
RETURN employee, certificate_count, active_project_count
ORDER BY certificate_count DESC, active_project_count DESC, employee ASC
LIMIT 10

MATCH (mentor:Employee)-[:MENTORS]->(mentee:Employee)
WITH mentor.name AS mentor_name,
     max(mentor.department) AS department,
     collect(DISTINCT mentee.name) AS mentee_names,
     max(mentor.max_projects) AS max_projects
WITH mentor_name, department, size(mentee_names) AS mentee_count
MATCH (e:Employee)
WHERE e.name = mentor_name
OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:HAS_POSITION]->(pos:Position)
WITH mentor_name, department, mentee_count, collect(DISTINCT pos.name) AS positions
WITH avg(mentee_count) AS avg_mentees_per_mentor,
     collect({mentor_name: mentor_name, department: department, positions: positions, mentee_count: mentee_count}) AS mentor_stats
UNWIND mentor_stats AS stat
WITH avg_mentees_per_mentor, stat
UNWIND CASE WHEN size(stat.positions) = 0 THEN [null] ELSE stat.positions END AS position_name
WITH avg_mentees_per_mentor,
     stat.department AS department,
     position_name,
     stat.mentee_count AS mentee_count
RETURN round(avg_mentees_per_mentor * 100.0) / 100.0 AS avg_mentees_per_mentor,
       department,
       position_name AS position,
       COUNT(*) AS mentor_count,
       round(avg(mentee_count) * 100.0) / 100.0 AS avg_mentees_in_group
ORDER BY mentor_count DESC, department ASC, position ASC
LIMIT 200

MATCH (e:Employee)-[w:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)
WHERE w.agreed_rate < e.hourly_rate
RETURN COUNT(w) AS lower_agreed_rate_assignments

MATCH (e:Employee)-[w:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)
WITH e.name AS employee, p.name AS project,
     SUM(COALESCE(w.allocated_hours, 0)) AS allocated_hours,
     SUM(COALESCE(w.actual_hours, 0)) AS actual_hours,
     SUM(COALESCE(w.actual_hours, 0) - COALESCE(w.allocated_hours, 0)) AS gap
RETURN employee, project, allocated_hours, actual_hours, gap
ORDER BY abs(gap) DESC, employee ASC, project ASC
LIMIT 200

MATCH (d:Department)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(e:Employee)-[:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)
WITH d.name AS department, max(d.budget_billion) AS department_budget_billion, SUM(DISTINCT p.budget_billion) AS project_budget_billion_sum
RETURN department, department_budget_billion, project_budget_billion_sum,
       CASE 
         WHEN department_budget_billion IS NULL OR department_budget_billion = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE toFloat(project_budget_billion_sum) / department_budget_billion
       END AS budget_ratio
ORDER BY budget_ratio DESC, department ASC

MATCH (d:Department)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(o:Office)
OPTIONAL MATCH (e:Employee)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(d)
WITH o.name AS office, COUNT(DISTINCT d.name) AS department_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) AS total_employees, SUM(DISTINCT d.budget_billion) AS total_department_budget_billion
RETURN office, department_count, total_employees, total_department_budget_billion
ORDER BY office

MATCH (p:Project)
WHERE p.type = $projectType
  AND p.status = $projectStatus
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)<-[:WORKS_ON]-(e:Employee)
WITH p.name AS project,
     p.required_headcount AS required_headcount,
     COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) AS current_headcount,
     (COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) - p.required_headcount) AS headcount_gap
RETURN project, required_headcount, current_headcount, headcount_gap
ORDER BY headcount_gap ASC, project ASC
LIMIT 200

MATCH (p:Project)-[req:REQUIRES]->(s:Skill)
WHERE toLower(p.name) = toLower($projectName)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)<-[w:WORKS_ON]-(e:Employee)-[hs:HAS_SKILL]->(s)
WITH p, req, s, w, e, hs,
     CASE req.required_proficiency
       WHEN '초급' THEN 1
       WHEN '중급' THEN 2
       WHEN '고급' THEN 3
       ELSE 0
     END AS requiredLevel,
     CASE hs.proficiency
       WHEN '초급' THEN 1
       WHEN '중급' THEN 2
       WHEN '고급' THEN 3
       WHEN '전문가' THEN 4
       ELSE 0
     END AS employeeLevel
WITH p, req, s,
     COLLECT(DISTINCT e) AS assignedEmployees,
     COLLECT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e IS NOT NULL AND employeeLevel >= requiredLevel THEN e END) AS coveringEmployees
RETURN p, req, s, assignedEmployees, coveringEmployees
LIMIT 200

MATCH (target:Project)
WHERE toLower(target.name) = toLower($projectName)
MATCH (e:Employee)-[hs:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill)
WHERE ANY(skill IN $skillNames WHERE toLower(s.name) = toLower(skill))
  AND NOT (e)-[:WORKS_ON]->(target)
WITH e.name AS employeeName,
     max(e.department) AS department,
     max(e.availability) AS availability,
     collect(DISTINCT s.name) AS matchedSkills,
     count(DISTINCT s.name) AS matchedSkillCount
WHERE matchedSkillCount > 0
RETURN employeeName, department, availability, matchedSkills, matchedSkillCount
ORDER BY matchedSkillCount DESC, employeeName ASC
LIMIT 200

윤지호의 Python 숙련도는 graph_results에서 '고급'으로 확인되므로 이 항목 자체는 위반이 아닙니다. 실질적 위반만 보면 아래 항목이 핵심입니다.

metadata.cypher_query:
MATCH (p:Project)-[req:REQUIRES]->(s:Skill)
WHERE toLower(p.name) = toLower($projectName)
  AND req.importance = '필수'
MATCH (e:Employee)-[hs:HAS_SKILL]->(s)
WHERE hs.effective_rate <= req.max_hourly_rate
OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[w:WORKS_ON]->(p2:Project)
WITH p, req, s, e.name AS employeeName,
     max(e.hourly_rate) AS hourlyRate,
     max(e.availability) AS availability,
     collect(DISTINCT hs.proficiency) AS proficiencies,
     count(DISTINCT s.name) AS matchedRequiredSkills,
     collect(DISTINCT s.name) AS matchedSkills,
     count(DISTINCT p2.name) AS currentProjectCount
WITH p, employeeName, hourlyRate, availability, matchedRequiredSkills, matchedSkills, currentProjectCount,
     count(DISTINCT req) AS totalRequiredSkills
WHERE matchedRequiredSkills = totalRequiredSkills
MATCH (e:Employee)
WHERE e.name = employeeName
OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[hs2:HAS_SKILL]->(s2:Skill)
WHERE s2.name IN matchedSkills
RETURN p, e, hs2, s2
LIMIT 200

MATCH (e:Employee)-[r:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill)
WHERE e.department = $department
  AND NOT ANY(excluded IN $excludedSkills WHERE toLower(s.name) = toLower(excluded))
RETURN e, r, s
LIMIT 200

MATCH (e:Employee)-[:HAS_CERTIFICATE]->(c:Certificate)
WHERE toLower(c.name) <> toLower($certificateName)
WITH e.name AS employee, COLLECT(DISTINCT c.name) AS certificates
RETURN employee, certificates
ORDER BY employee
LIMIT 200
